properties.name: Austin 1839 (Waller grid, nominal 640 acres)

properties.name: Tonkawa: Central Texas homeland as described for the early 1800s
properties.precision_note: SCHEMATIC. Vertices rounded to about 0.1 degree and drawn from a TEXT description in the cited source. Not surveyed, not tribally approved, not a border. Peoples overlapped, moved seasonally and shifted over decades. Before public release consult the tribal governments and Native Land Digital (native-land.ca).
properties.source: Texas Highways, "Recognizing Local History: Tonkawa Tribe, the Original Texans": homelands between the Trinity and Colorado rivers; TSHA Handbook of Texas, "Tonkawa Indians": independent bands united in Central Texas in the early 1700s.
properties.render_hint: no stroke; soft-edged or hatched fill; never clip one zone with another; show the source label on hover

properties.name: Lipan Apache (Nde): Many Houses homeland and South Texas range, tribal account
properties.precision_note: SCHEMATIC. Vertices rounded to about 0.1 degree and drawn from a TEXT description in the cited source. Not surveyed, not tribally approved, not a border. Peoples overlapped, moved seasonally and shifted over decades. Before public release consult the tribal governments and Native Land Digital (native-land.ca).
properties.source: Lipan Apache Tribe of Texas (same sources): San Antonio area claimed as homeland; range San Antonio to Laredo and Refugio to Nueces County; part of the tribe moved into Coahuila in 1751. An academic account (Traversea, 2014) gives an 18th-century homeland from the Edwards Plateau to the mountains of Coahuila. The National Park Service (Fort Davis) says the Lipan were driven south of the Rio Grande by 1800 and returned after Mexican independence.

properties.name: East Austin: 1928 plan district / Six Square (I-35, Manor Rd, Airport Blvd, E 7th St)
properties.precision_note: Union of 2020 Census tracts with at least half their area inside a rough polygon of the named bounding roads. Tract edges follow those roads closely but not exactly.
properties.boundary_definition: North: Manor Road. South: East 7th Street. East: Airport Boulevard. West: I-35 (former East Avenue).
properties.area_discrepancy_note: The land enclosed by the four named streets measures roughly 3 to 4 square miles in this approximation, not 6. Treat "six square miles" as the name-giving figure reported by Six Square and the press, and verify against a surveyed boundary before quoting an area.
properties.source: Six Square boundary statement as published in the Texas Time Travel directory (Texas Historical Commission heritage trails), Visit Austin and KVUE (2026); Koch & Fowler, A City Plan for Austin, Texas (1928)
properties.documentation_validity: Well-Documented (bounding streets); the 1928 plan text gives no surveyed boundary
properties.significance: Area the 1928 plan recommended as the district for Black residents; since 2013 the Six Square Black cultural district.
properties.boundary_changed_over_time: The same four streets describe the 1928 district and the 2013 cultural district. NBHD_EAST_AUSTIN_CONTEMPORARY and the HOLC grade D areas are different footprints: do not interchange them.

properties.name: East Austin: common present-day usage (I-35 to US 183, river to US 290 E)
properties.precision_note: Union of 2020 Census tracts with at least half their area inside a rough polygon of the named bounding roads. Tract edges follow those roads closely but not exactly.
properties.boundary_definition: West: I-35. East: US 183. South: Colorado River. North: US 290 East. No official definition exists.
properties.source: Constructed for this tool; not an official boundary
properties.significance: Frame for 2000-2026 demographic change. The IUPRA figure (Black population -66 percent, 2000-2010) uses a narrower, study-defined tract set; load that tract list before charting those numbers.
properties.boundary_changed_over_time: Usage widened eastward as the city annexed toward and beyond US 183.

properties.name: Fourth Street / Warehouse District LGBTQ+ cluster
properties.precision_note: Hand-built from the named bounding streets; expect 100-300 m error. Replace with City of Austin open-data or National Register shapefiles before publication.
